main_measure.name: mean sign(forecast) x excess 5-bar return, top |forecast| quintile, pooled
main_measure.threshold: confirm t >= 2, reject t <= -2, with at least 30 top-quintile cases

supporting_check.name: top-quintile mean minus other-four-quintiles mean of signed excess return

decided_by: Confirm: t >= 2 with at least 30 top-quintile cases and a positive top-minus-other difference.
reading: The top quintile of each coin is the 20% of its grid cases with the largest |forecast| (ranked with ties broken by time order, cases with rank above 0.8 x n), zero forecasts included with sign 0, and fewer than 30 top-quintile cases is reported as not observable.
